comparators.output: Reuse paid rate until expiration<gameTime; on renewal debit matching melting fuel and scale duration by interval/partial amount; only persist lease covering next interval; remove paid lease on modifier removal
comparators.preservation: Read complete OverburnModule and OverslimeModule/ToolTankHelper/ModDataNBT plus ToolStack persistent owner and CapacityBarHook consumers. Absolute gameTime checkpoint prevents treating paid fuel as a fresh full duration after reload, while full shield or active bow skips refill; paid lease can expire without catch-up. Tank payload remains actual item persistent compound. Independent actual owner/consumer review: ModifierProvider 1507 注册 overburn 模块、1000mB容量和 tank handler。ModifiableItem.inventoryTick 319-322 委派 heldInventoryTick，后者 ToolStack.from(stack) 并调每 modifier INVENTORY_TICK。 ToolStack.from 147-183 对正常已有 tag 工具不复制 NBT；构造保存同一 tag 引用。getPersistentData 617-628 对实际 persistent compound 包装，新建时写回该工具 NBT。 FuelInfo.read/write 65-80 用 modifier id compound 存 expiration/rate；onRemoved 50-51 删除该资格。 Overburn 94-127 仅服务端到周期、非正在使用、盾未满时，过期才查匹配 fuel；真实扣工具流体，部分量按比例缩短时长。 Overburn 132-147 仅跨度足够下一周期才持久化新资格，但本次非空短资格仍可补一次；未过期复用已付 rate，无再次流体扣除。 OverslimeModule/CapacityBarHook 读取/写入工具持久 overslime，补给受当前容量和 overworked 限制；DurabilityShieldModule 64-98 实际减少 shield 并减免工具耐久伤害，helper 不是第二条 credit。 Distinction: 不是因 fluid/overslime 换名计数。工具自持有的已付款 deadline+rate，与实际流体库存扣除、持有者世界时、级别决定的补给周期和可消耗护盾容量耦合；存档恢复的是未来补给资格而非只剩一份流体或重启满时长。现有 FuelModule 是机器剩余计数加温度的熔炼消费者；Embers 是在线递减的系数持续期；Occultism 交换在付款当下给物品后限制下次购买；ToolStack 账目是材料重定向和派生统计重建。这些没有覆盖可移动工具以绝对到期时间消费已付补充资格的生命周期，因此本条完整付费/恢复/消费链建议最多1。所有 NBT/tank/capacity/hooks/盾伤害 helper 均只支持0。
comparators.application_limit: expiration < time 才续费，恰好到期仍有效；time+duration 与 duration*interval 有溢出/截断边界，level 仅限上界6。 盾已满或正在用物品时跳过补给，世界时间仍走；没有离线补发，不把它当永久护盾或全额保证。跨维度时钟一致性未验证。 outer compound 有类型检查，inner expiration/rate 无显式类型/范围校验；原生默认行为没有本轮外部源码验证。 ToolStack 正常引用接线已补读，仍未原生读盘/写盘测试；材料JSON生成加载、完整 modifier registry dispatch、配方 lookup 以及全部伤害入口没有展开。 付费与持久资格写入没有磁盘事务；不保证进程中断不丢不重，也不赋予玩家死亡Clone保留权。

proposals.mechanism: Meat is consumed to raise bounded persistent size. Resizable read invokes virtual setSize after base restoration: Chimera rebuilds transient damage/speed and base scale from saved size. Size above80 enables owner riding; shrink below threshold ejects passengers. Golden apple consumes once and clears persisted hasGoat before creating detached goat, selecting inherited ring/beard/owner and capping copied size50.
proposals.dedup: Base familiar flags and permanent smith modifiers already ff97; not recredited. Native slime2f9 already covers size-derived stats, so size setter alone is support0. Proposed distinction is actual paid growth coupled to persistently consumed detachable component and selected cross-entity state, not another pet species, shape, timer or transient attack animation. Goat/Shub helpers and same-file DummyBoost36c141b501bb26d2faae add0.
limits: Recommendation needs coordinator semantic review; use0 if paid-growth plus detachment is judged insufficient beyond existing size/custody families.
Feeding has no explicit server guard or owner requirement; cast to byte occurs before clamp. Not a validated nutrition overflow exploit.
Spawn success is unchecked after debit and clearing goat flag; not atomic exactly-once delivery.

Detached goat does not copy permanent upgrade flags, full attributes or original name; later Shub conversion does not copy size. These are selected-copy boundaries, not promises of universal preservation.
Natural shrink is online server random chance unless smith upgraded. No offline decay computation observed.
Capture/release reuses shared familiar carrier; no new carrier credit. World and carried ticking differ.
